name: Like a Boss
author: Addicting Games
description: Like a Boss is a racing game. In Like A Boss you need to survive the zig-zag highways of the future for as long as you possibly can. All you have to do in this nerve-tingling racing game is click, hold, and let go. Of course, if you want to be an effective driver who is able to survive you'll have to know when to click, how long to hold, and only let go at the appropriate time. This is a simple mechanism but as the roads become more dangerous and difficult to navigate, it will become trickier and trickier to hold on. This is an endless style game where the levels don't end: you do. You're here to stay alive longer than any other player and climb your way to the top of the leaderboard using your reflexes and a little luck. Do you think you have what it takes to overcome the obstacles, slalom through the tightest corners and hold on long enough to become the leader of the pack? Will you rise above an prove that you have what it takes to put pedal to the metal and swish across the finish line like a boss? Well, here is your chance to prove it.
